heading: FAQ’s on Travel App Development Solutions

items.question: Can the app connect to airline and hotel APIs?
items.answer: Yes. We integrate with relevant supplier APIs or let partners manage inventory directly.

items.question: How long does it take to launch?
items.answer: A branded launch typically takes 6–8 weeks, depending on integrations and customisation.

items.question: Does it support multiple currencies?
items.answer: Yes. Multi-currency and multilingual support is available.

items.question: Can partners manage their own listings?
items.answer: Yes. Partners get their own app and dashboard.

items.question: Can I earn commissions?
items.answer: Yes. Commissions and markups can be configured in the admin panel.

items.question: How much does a travel app cost?
items.answer: Cost depends on features and integrations. Share your requirements for an estimate.
